DuckWriter is a free word processor for Windows that opens and saves Word documents (.docx), with what scientific writing needs: equations, footnotes, captions and cross-references, citations and a reference list, tracked changes and comments.

## Install

1. Download **DuckWriter-Setup.exe** below. That one file is all you need.
2. Run it. Windows may say "Windows protected your PC", because the installer isn't code-signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. Open DuckWriter from the Start menu, or right-click a Word document and choose **Open with**.

It needs Windows 10 or 11. Your documents stay on your computer; DuckWriter only goes online to check for updates and, if you ask it to, to look up a DOI.

The "Source code" files below are added by GitHub automatically; you don't need them.
